$comment: Spec/manifest declaring the kit's placeholder set. Consumed by bootstrap.sh to write the .claude/.config skeleton (probe-seeded values + defaults applied + null for unfilled). Also describes per-key metadata (type, required, default, description) used by /fill-config (deferred) and /audit-kit kit-version delta detection. NOT a draft-07 JSON Schema validating .claude/.config — that file is a flat KEY → scalar map; this file is the manifest describing which KEYs the kit defines. Repo-root references are NOT a placeholder — canonical files use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR directly (the harness env var, evaluated at runtime). See docs/DECISIONS.md → 2026-04-30 Substitute subsystem (Q2.5).

PROJECT_NAME.description: Human-readable project name. Appears in CLAUDE.md, docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/PITFALLS.md, ship.md.

TEST_COMMAND.description: Test runner command (e.g. 'npm run test', 'pytest', 'cargo test'). Use 'n/a' if the project has no tests yet.

BUILD_COMMAND.description: Standard build command (e.g. 'npm run build', 'cargo build'). Use 'n/a' if the project has no build step.

LONG_BUILD_COMMAND.description: The slow build command that must NOT be chained with `&&` (HARD RULE). Often equal to BUILD_COMMAND; sometimes a heavier variant.

LONG_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the long build, used by /verify and other long-build invocations. 60000 ms = 1 min, 600000 ms = 10 min.

QUALITY_GATE_FAST_STEPS.description: Fast tests + lint + validate steps chained with `&&` (e.g. 'npm run test && npm run lint'). Used by /verify, /ship, /review-pr.

QUALITY_GATE_ONE_LINER.description: Single-line full quality gate for the stop-checklist warning banner. Typically test + build.

QUALITY_GATE_SCRIPT.description: Optional project-specific full quality-gate script invoked by /review-pr (e.g. 'npm run quality-gate', 'bash scripts/qa.sh'). Empty string disables the step.

POST_BUILD_CHECKS.description: Post-build verification + regression greps (e.g. 'npm run validate'). Used by /verify, /ship, /review-pr.

PIPELINE_SENTINEL_FILE.description: Path (relative to repo root) of a file whose absence means the build hasn't run. Inspected by hooks/session-start-orient.sh.

APPEND_ONLY_FILES.description: Comma-separated list of files where rebase conflicts must keep BOTH sides (no deletions). Surfaced by /review-pr.

MAX_DEFERRED_CONSIDERS.description: Issue #41 debt cap. CI fails when open issues with label `consider-deferred` exceed this count. Pair with /review-pr Stage 5 DEFER:<reason> friction.

CTX_BUDGET_TOKENS.description: Issue #99 (cpt-kit-harvest W2). Per-session context budget in tokens for the ctx-tracker hooks (context-tracker-init.sh, context-tracker-check.sh). The kit default; a runtime CTX_BUDGET_TOKENS env var overrides it per session. buy.vodka-v3 harvest bumped the default from 100000 to 125000.
